title: Meridian start state, version 2
description: What run state holds of what a run's Start gave, as compile.EncodeStartState writes it: the run's values but for those that are private, the run's timeout unless it is private, and the matrices Start expanded, each private instance without its matrix values.

version.description: The version of the plan the run was started from.

timeoutSeconds.description: The run's timeout, in seconds, unless evaluating it read a variable or a password.

timeoutPrivate.description: Set when evaluating the run's timeout read a variable or a password: the secret record holds it.

expansions.description: The matrices Start expanded, by job name.
